title: KG reference mapping and visualization
summary: Contract for the on-demand kg_document_refs mapping service: match kinds, disk cache validity, byte-offset semantics, and the two consuming visualization surfaces.
notes: SPEC vs DOC ambiguity. Prose-heavy with design rationale (DOC signal), but dominant content is implementation contracts the system must honor: command signature and return type, match-kind definitions, output caps (20 spans/note, 200 total), cache validity conditions, UTF-8 byte-offset semantics, referenceFocus payload shape, and two hard rendering constraints. Resolved to SPEC per precedence rule. No ADR signals (no status/decision/consequences) and no PRD signals (no user stories or acceptance criteria). cross_refs empty: all path mentions are source files (src-tauri/src/kg_refs.rs, src/lib/kgRefs.ts, e2e/kg-references.spec.ts), not documents.
